meta.summary: AI spend governed at 2.1x sector median with strict controls, frontier exceptions requiring CFO approval within 24 hours, and agent kill thresholds at $20 per hour.

shadow_ai.reimbursement_rule: AI tool purchases on personal or employee cards are not reimbursable; all AI subscriptions must be procured through the approved vendor catalog.

response_ladder.trigger: Team envelope reaches 75% consumed in a billing month
Team envelope reaches 100% consumed with 7 or more days remaining in the month
Company envelope reaches 100% consumed with 5 or more days remaining in the month

rationales.e1: Support team production inference at $211 daily run rate clears the $100 Support envelope on a per-day basis; classify as COGS under the production environment rule and monitor against the $100 team envelope.
rationales.e2: Nightly embeddings at $38 falls within the Data team envelope of $300 per month and matches the cost-per-pipeline-run metric; no action required.
rationales.e3: Search team cost per request rose 96% overnight with flat volume, breaching the 20% variance band; likely cause is a model routing change or prompt-length regression introduced in the deploy.
rationales.e4: Marketing team has reached 1 duplicate AI chat subscription this quarter, hitting the team_subscription_threshold of 1; the $30 charge is rerouted to the approved OpenAI contract and the employee card transaction is blocked.
rationales.e5: Fine-tune estimate of $4,800 exceeds the $1,000 approval threshold; routed to CTO for sign-off before the job is queued.
rationales.e6: The research agent reached 340 calls per hour, exceeding the 10-retry limit per task, and was burning at $47 per hour against the $20 per hour kill threshold; the loop was terminated, preventing an estimated $1,090 in uncontrolled spend.
rationales.e7: Growth team frontier exception for the demo build is within the 24-hour window and the incremental cost delta is within the $100 cap; approved pending CFO sign-off per the frontier exception rule.
rationales.e8: Personal API key usage at 22x baseline with no project tag triggers ladder step 2 throttle; experimentation carve-out is preserved at baseline rate until the engineer applies a valid project tag.
rationales.e9: Procurement agent dataset purchase of $499 falls within the $500 single-transaction ceiling and the data-licensing merchant scope; transaction approved.
rationales.e10: Design team trial at $89 per month duplicates the Sales team video tool contract at $1,400 per year with 40% seat utilization; consolidating onto the existing contract recovers $840 in annualized unused seat value.
rationales.e11: Charge of $120 from an unrecognized inference provider in Engineering triggers the require_approval rule; CTO must review the vendor security questionnaire before further charges are permitted.
rationales.e12: Inference tagged to an internal tool is reclassified from COGS to OpEx under the project_tag internal-tool rule; no spend impact, ledger entry corrected.
rationales.e13: Month-to-date spend at 87% of the company envelope with 9 days remaining has crossed the 75% burn alert threshold; pacing is flagged to the CFO and team leads for discretionary spend review.
rationales.e14: Weekly rollup complete; all team envelopes, agent guardrails, and classification rules reconciled with no open exceptions.
